definition_zh: 门（生物分类中位于界之下、纲之上的阶元）
definition_en: a primary rank in biological classification, below kingdom and above class, defined mainly by body plan
core_image: 博物馆展厅按身体构型把动物分到不同的门，每个展厅入口挂着一块说明牌
scene: 博物馆的展厅按身体构型把动物分类，每个入口挂着一块说明牌。 The museum's galleries place each animal group in a separate phylum by body plan, with a label at every entrance.
sceneCN: 这里 phylum 是「门」（第 1 个义项：界之下、纲之上的主要分类阶元）；句意：博物馆展厅按身体构型把每一类动物放进一个单独的门，每个入口挂着说明牌。

pos.zh: 门（复数 phyla）

senses.title: The primary rank below kingdom
senses.titleCN: 位于界之下的主要阶元
senses.definition: a major division of a kingdom, grouping classes that share a fundamental body plan
senses.definitionCN: 界之下的一个主要划分，把共享基本身体构型的若干纲聚合起来
senses.example: The museum groups animals into different phyla by body plan.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆按身体构型把动物分到不同的门。
senses.why: New Latin phylum was taken from Greek phylon 'race, tribe'; the rank names a whole branch of the living world rather than a single kind.
senses.whyCN: 新拉丁语 phylum 取自希腊语 phylon「族、支系」；这个阶元命名的是一整条生物界的支系，而非单个种类。

senses.title: A body plan as the defining mark
senses.titleCN: 以身体构型为界定标志
senses.definition: the level at which animals are separated by overall architecture, such as radial or bilateral symmetry and the presence of a backbone
senses.definitionCN: 按整体构造把动物分开的层级，如辐射或两侧对称、有无脊椎
senses.example: A new body plan is what justifies a new phylum.
senses.exampleCN: 一个新的身体构型，正是设立一个新门的理由。
senses.why: Unlike a species, a phylum is not defined by breeding but by architecture: what is shared is a way of being built, and that is why the rank is so deep.
senses.whyCN: 与物种不同，门不是由繁殖而是由构造界定：共享的是一种建造方式，这正是这个阶元如此深层的原因。

senses.title: The botanical equivalent: division
senses.titleCN: 植物学中的对应等级：部
senses.definition: in botanical nomenclature, the rank called division or divisio, which corresponds to phylum in zoology
senses.definitionCN: 植物命名法中称为部（divisio）的等级，相当于动物学中的门
senses.example: Botanists traditionally say division where zoologists say phylum.
senses.exampleCN: 动物学家说门的地方，植物学家传统上说部。
senses.why: Two codes grew separately, so the same level carries two names; recognizing the equivalence prevents a reader from thinking a rank is missing.
senses.whyCN: 两套法规各自成长，因此同一层级有两个名称；认清这种对应，读者才不会以为少了一级。

senses.title: The plural phyla
senses.definition: the New Latin plural used in English for several phyla, following the Greek neuter pattern
senses.definitionCN: 按希腊中性模式构成的拉丁复数，英语中用于指多个门
senses.example: Thirty-two phyla are recognized in the animal kingdom.
senses.exampleCN: 动物界现被承认的有三十二个门。
senses.why: The plural is a Greek-style -a form, not an English -s; technical writing keeps it because the codes do.
senses.whyCN: 复数是希腊式的 -a 形式，而非英语的 -s；技术写作沿用，因为法规如此。

senses.title: The major animal phyla in teaching
senses.titleCN: 教学中列举的主要动物门
senses.definition: the short list of well-known phyla used to introduce animal diversity, such as arthropods, molluscs and chordates
senses.definitionCN: 用于介绍动物多样性的少数知名门，如节肢动物、软体动物与脊索动物
senses.example: The course covers eight phyla in one semester.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课一学期讲八个门。
senses.why: Teaching compresses diversity into a handful of names; the short list is a pedagogical selection, not a claim that the others do not exist.
senses.whyCN: 教学把多样性压缩成少数名称；这份短名单是教学上的选取，并不表示其余的门不存在。

senses.title: Phylum boundaries under molecular revision
senses.titleCN: 分子数据修订下的门界
senses.definition: the redrawing of phylum limits when sequence data show that traditional body plans hide deeper relationships
senses.definitionCN: 当序列数据显示传统身体构型掩盖了更深关系时，对门的界线所作的重新划定
senses.example: Molecular data merged two phyla that had been separated for a century.
senses.exampleCN: 分子数据把两个已分隔一个世纪的门合并了。
senses.why: A body plan can converge, so similarity of architecture is not proof of kinship; when sequences disagree with shape, the rank's boundary is reopened.
senses.whyCN: 身体构型可能趋同，因此构造相似并不能证明亲缘；当序列与外形不一致，门的界线就会被重新打开。

senses.title: A phylum-level lineage in phylogenetics
senses.titleCN: 系统发生学中的门级支系
senses.definition: a deep branch of the tree of life, treated as a phylum-level lineage even before a formal rank is assigned
senses.definitionCN: 生命树上的一个深层分支，在正式阶元尚未确定之前就被当作门级支系
senses.example: The uncultured microbes form a phylum-level lineage of their own.
senses.exampleCN: 这些尚未培养的微生物自成一个门级支系。
senses.why: Sequences can reveal a deep branch before anyone can name its anatomy, so the word is used for the branch itself rather than for a described body plan.
senses.whyCN: 序列可以在任何人描述其解剖结构之前就揭示一个深层分支，因此这个词被用于分支本身，而非已被描述的身体构型。

senses.title: No fixed suffix for phylum names
senses.definition: the convention that phylum names are not governed by a single ending, unlike families, so their form must be learned name by name
senses.definitionCN: 门名不像科名那样由单一词尾管束，其形式须逐个记诵的惯例
senses.example: Phylum names have no common ending, so each one must be learned separately.
senses.exampleCN: 门名没有共同词尾，因此只能一个一个地记。
senses.why: Codes standardize the endings of families and orders, but phylum names are old and irregular; the absence of a rule is itself the rule to remember.
senses.whyCN: 法规统一了科与目的词尾，门名却古老而不规则；没有规则，正是需要记住的规则。

intro.en: Phylum is a New Latin noun coined from Greek phylon 'race, tribe, stock', which derives from phyein 'to grow'. Ernst Haeckel introduced it as a rank in the nineteenth century. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: phylum 是依希腊语 phylon「族、支系、种系」造的新拉丁语名词，后者出自 phyein「生长」。海克尔在 19 世纪把它引入为分类阶元。年代为约数。

items.en: Phylon meant 'race, tribe, stock', and phyle named a tribe or a military division of the Athenian state.
items.cn: phylon 意为「族、部落、种系」，phylē 指雅典城邦的部落或军事划分。

items.en: The word is tied to phyein 'to grow, bring forth', and to physis 'nature'. The sense is a stock that has grown from one root.
items.cn: 该词与 phyein「生长、产生」及 physis「自然」相关。其义为从一个根生长出来的一支种系。

items.en: Ernst Haeckel introduced phylum as a rank above class, using the Greek word for a stock or tribe.
items.cn: 海克尔于 1866 年引入 phylum 作为纲之上的阶元，用的是希腊语中表示种系或部落的词。

items.en: Zoology adopted the rank for the great body plans, while botany kept division for the same level.
items.cn: 动物学采用这个阶元来指几大身体构型，植物学则在同层级沿用 division（部）。

items.en: Sequence data forced many phylum boundaries to be redrawn, and some deep branches are now called phylum-level lineages before they are formally named.
items.cn: 序列数据迫使许多门界被重划；一些深层分支在正式命名之前就已被称作门级支系。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the exact first English use of phylum as a rank is not fixed here, and the pre-Greek origin of phyein is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：phylum 作为阶元最早的英语使用此处无法确定；phyein 在希腊语之前的来源属重构形式。

note.en: Group one separates words built on the Greek phylon stock; group two compares the ranks around phylum.
note.cn: 第一组区分同出希腊 phylon 词干的词；第二组比较门周围的各个阶元。

entries.definition: The plural of phylum, formed on the Greek neuter pattern. It is the same rank in another number.
entries.definitionCN: phylum 的复数，按希腊中性模式构成。它是同一阶元的另一种数。

entries.definition: Relating to a phylum or to a line of descent, from Greek phyletikos. It describes lineage, not a rank.
entries.definitionCN: 与门或与一条血统线有关的，出自希腊 phyletikos。它描述谱系，而非阶元。

entries.definition: The evolutionary history of a group, from phylon plus genesis. It is the history that a phylum's name summarizes.
entries.definitionCN: 一个类群的演化史，由 phylon 加 genesis 构成。它是门名所概括的那段历史。

entries.definition: A common misspelling with an extra l, confusing phylum with Greek phyllon 'leaf'. It is not a word.
entries.definitionCN: 常见的多写一个 l 的拼错形式，把 phylum 与希腊 phyllon「叶」混淆。它不是词。

entries.definition: The botanical rank corresponding to phylum, used for plants and fungi; the two codes name one level differently.
entries.definitionCN: 植物与真菌中相当于门的等级；两套法规对同一层级用了不同名称。

entries.definition: The rank immediately below phylum; a phylum is divided into classes.
entries.definitionCN: 紧接在门之下的阶元；一个门被分为若干纲。

entries.definition: The rank above phylum in the traditional hierarchy; a kingdom contains several phyla.
entries.definitionCN: 传统层级中门之上的阶元；一个界包含若干门。

entries.definition: The overall architecture that defines a phylum; it is the evidence, while phylum is the rank.
entries.definitionCN: 界定一个门的整体构造；它是证据，而门是阶元。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: phylon was a tribe or stock: a phylum is one great stock of the living world.
normal.cn: phylon 是部落或种系：一个门就是生物界的一支大种系。

normal.en: The plural is phyla, on the Greek pattern, and technical writing keeps it.
normal.cn: 复数是 phyla，按希腊模式构成，技术写作沿用。

normal.en: Body plan, not breeding, defines the rank; that is why a phylum is so deep.
normal.cn: 界定这个阶元的是身体构型而非繁殖；这就是门如此深层的原因。

normal.en: Zoologists say phylum, botanists say division for the same level.
normal.cn: 同一层级，动物学家说 phylum，植物学家说 division。

normal.en: Phylum names have no fixed ending, unlike family names with -aceae or -idae.
normal.cn: 门名没有固定词尾，不像科名带 -aceae 或 -idae。

abstract.en: Picture a building whose foundations are poured once and never changed.
abstract.cn: 想象一座建筑，地基浇一次就再也不改。

abstract.en: Picture a tree so old that its first branches are thicker than the twigs at the top.
abstract.cn: 想象一棵老树，最初的分枝比树梢的细枝还粗。

abstract.en: Picture a map where the largest regions are drawn by hand and the small ones by rule.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图，最大的区域靠手绘，小区域靠规则。

examples.en: Arthropods form the largest phylum in the animal kingdom.
examples.cn: 节肢动物构成动物界最大的门。

examples.en: The two groups were placed in one phylum only after their larvae were compared.
examples.cn: 这两个类群直到比较了幼体之后才被放进同一个门。

examples.en: Botanists call the same level a division, not a phylum.
examples.cn: 植物学家把同一层级称作部，而不是门。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「phy 飞 + lum 来」——一大支一起飞来的族群 → phylum 门

root: 新拉丁语 phylum，取自希腊语 phylon「族、支系、种系」，出自 phyein「生长」；海克尔于 1866 年引入为阶元。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of phylum move from the rank itself to its body-plan criterion, the botanical equivalent, the plural, the teaching shortlist, molecular redrawing, the phylogenetic branch and the absence of a fixed ending.
sensesIntro.cn: phylum 的八个义项从阶元本身出发，依次是身体构型这一判据、植物学中的对应等级、复数、教学短名单、分子数据的重划、系统发生上的分支，以及固定词尾的缺席。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one deep foundation plan shared by many buildings, cut off from the rest of the city.
core.cn: 核心意象：一份被许多建筑共享的深层地基图，从城市其余部分被切分出来。

branches.en: THE RANK AND ITS TEST: a phylum is a great stock defined by architecture, not by breeding.
branches.cn: 阶元与判据：门是由构造而非繁殖界定的一支大种系。

branches.en: THE FORM: botanists say division for the same level, and the plural is phyla.
branches.cn: 形式：植物学家把同一层级称作部，复数则是 phyla。

branches.en: THE TEACHING SHORTLIST: a few familiar phyla stand for the whole diversity.
branches.cn: 教学短名单：少数熟悉的门代表全部多样性。

branches.en: THE REVISION: sequences reopen boundaries and reveal branches before anatomy is known.
branches.cn: 修订：序列重新打开界线，并在解剖结构已知之前揭示分支。

branches.en: NO FIXED ENDING: phylum names must be learned one by one because no code fixes their form.
branches.cn: 没有固定词尾：门名只能逐个记诵，因为法规不统一其形式。

intro.en: Phylum is Greek in origin and New Latin in form; its meaning is a stock or tribe, and its use is a rank.
intro.cn: phylum 源自希腊语、成形于新拉丁语；意义是种系或部落，用途是分类阶元。

latinIntro.en: There is no classical Latin noun phylum; the Latin entry is the New Latin rank term, while the Greek items are listed because they carry the meaning.
latinIntro.cn: 古典拉丁语没有 phylum 这一名词；拉丁词条列表所收为作为阶元术语的新拉丁语词，希腊成分则另列，因为它们承载词义。

items.example: Phylon supplies the sense of one great stock.
items.exampleCN: phylon 提供「一支大种系」的意思。

items.example: The stock is what has grown from one root.
items.exampleCN: 种系就是从一条根生长出来的东西。

items.meaning: a primary division of a kingdom
items.example: A phylum groups classes that share a body plan.
items.exampleCN: 门把共享身体构型的纲聚合起来。

items.example: Thirty-two phyla are recognized in animals.
items.exampleCN: 动物界现被承认三十二个门。

items.meaning: relating to a line of descent
items.example: Phyletic change is change along a lineage.
items.exampleCN: 谱系变化是沿一条血统线的变化。

items.example: Phylogeny is the history a phylum name summarizes.
items.exampleCN: 系统发生是门名所概括的历史。

items.example: Botany calls the same level a division.
items.exampleCN: 植物学把同一层级称作部。

items.example: A phylum divides into classes.
items.exampleCN: 一个门分为若干纲。

items.example: A kingdom contains several phyla.
items.exampleCN: 一个界包含若干门。

definition_zh: 包围；笼罩；覆盖
definition_en: to cover, surround, or close in around something completely
core_image: 浓雾从四面包上来，山谷、道路与屋顶一起消失在白幕里
scene: 清晨的大雾把整片河谷裹住。 Dense fog enveloped the whole valley.
sceneCN: 这里 envelop 是「笼罩；包围」（第 1 个义项：从四周完全盖住）；句意：浓雾笼罩了整个河谷。

pos.zh: 包围；笼罩；覆盖

senses.title: To cover something on every side
senses.definition: to surround a thing so that it cannot be seen or reached
senses.definitionCN: 从四周围住某物，使其无法看见或触及
senses.example: Flames enveloped the upper floor.
senses.exampleCN: 火焰吞没了上层楼面。
senses.why: The Latin stem means to roll in, and rolling something all the way around is exactly covering.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词干意为卷入，把四周滚满正是彻底覆盖。

senses.title: To close in around a military force
senses.definition: to surround troops or a position so that escape is cut off
senses.definitionCN: 包围军队或阵地，切断其退路
senses.example: Two brigades enveloped the crossing.
senses.exampleCN: 两个旅包围了渡口。
senses.why: Doctrine borrowed the word for the manoeuvre that wraps around an enemy flank.
senses.whyCN: 军事条令借用这个词指包抄敌军侧翼的机动。

senses.title: To take something up so it loses its outline
senses.definition: to absorb a smaller thing into a larger atmosphere or situation
senses.definitionCN: 把较小的事物吸收进更大的氛围或情境之中
senses.example: The crowd enveloped the returning runner.
senses.exampleCN: 人群把归来的跑者团团围住。
senses.why: Extended to feelings and crowds, the verb describes losing edges rather than physical covering.
senses.whyCN: 延伸到情绪与人群时，动词描述的是边界的消失而非实体覆盖。

intro.en: Envelop comes from Old French envellir, built on Latin involvere, to roll into.
intro.cn: envelop 来自古法语 envellir，建立在拉丁语 involvere（卷入）之上。

items.en: Volvere means to roll or turn.
items.cn: volvere 意为滚动或转动。

items.en: Involvere means to roll in or wrap up.
items.cn: involvere 意为卷入或包裹。

items.en: Envellir and envoler carry the rolling sense into French.
items.cn: envellir 与 envoler 把滚动义带入法语。

items.en: English records envelop as a verb of wrapping.
items.cn: 中古英语记录 envelop，表包裹。

items.en: Military writing fixes the sense of encircling a foe.
items.cn: 十九世纪军事文体固定包围敌军之义。

items.en: The noun envelope keeps the paper wrapper sense.
items.cn: 现代英语中名词 envelope 保留纸封套义。

note.en: Group one holds the volvere family and the paper noun; group two holds other verbs of surrounding.
note.cn: 第一组是 volvere 词族与纸封名词；第二组是其他表包围的动词。

entries.definition: The paper wrapper or a covering layer, spelled with an extra letter.
entries.definitionCN: 纸封套或覆盖层，拼写多一个字母。

entries.definition: The state or manoeuvre of surrounding, common in tactics.
entries.definitionCN: 包围状态或机动，战术用语常见。

entries.definition: To roll into a situation, hence to include or implicate.
entries.definitionCN: 卷入情境，引申为包含或牵连。

entries.definition: To roll back around, used of orbits and repeated questions.
entries.definitionCN: 绕回转动，用于轨道与反复讨论。

entries.definition: The everyday verb for being all around something.
entries.definitionCN: 表四周环绕的日常动词。

entries.definition: To close off within a boundary, often on paper or in a wall.
entries.definitionCN: 在界线内封闭，常用于信封或围墙。

entries.definition: To cover so that sight is blocked, with a funerary image.
entries.definitionCN: 遮盖至不可见，带裹尸布的意象。

entries.definition: To take in as a gulf does, stronger and more violent.
entries.definitionCN: 如深渊吞入，语气更强更猛。

normalIntro.en: Envelop without the final e is the verb; with an extra e it becomes the paper noun.
normalIntro.cn: 动词是 envelop，多写一个 e 就成了信封这个名词。

normal.en: The verb has one p; the noun envelope has two.
normal.cn: 动词只有一个 p，名词 envelope 有两个。

normal.en: Fog, smoke, darkness, and silence are the usual subjects.
normal.cn: 雾、烟、黑暗与沉默是最常见的主语。

normal.en: Use the passive for weather: the village was enveloped in mist.
normal.cn: 写天气多用被动：村庄被雾霭笼罩。

normal.en: In military prose envelop names a flanking movement.
normal.cn: 军事文体中 envelop 指迂回包抄行动。

normal.en: Do not use it for folding letters; that is the noun's job.
normal.cn: 不要用动词指封信动作，那是名词的领域。

abstract.en: Picture mist rolling in from four directions at once.
abstract.cn: 想象雾气从四个方向同时漫拢过来。

abstract.en: Imagine a blanket pulled over a sleeping child.
abstract.cn: 想象给熟睡的孩子拉上一床毯子。

abstract.en: Think of a crowd closing so a single figure disappears inside it.
abstract.cn: 想想人群合拢，一个人的身影消失其中。

examples.en: Ash soon enveloped the hillside villages.
examples.cn: 火山灰很快笼罩了山坡上的村庄。

examples.en: A hush enveloped the hall before the speech.
examples.cn: 演讲开始前大厅一片寂静。

examples.en: The plan was to envelop the bridge from both banks.
examples.cn: 计划是从两岸包围桥头。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因围了铺」——因为围起来像铺了一层布，所以 envelop 是笼罩、包围；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 in-（向内）＋ volvere（滚）→ involvere（卷入）→ 古法语 envellir → 中古英语 envelopen → 现代英语 envelop，核心义「从四周滚拢包住」。

sensesIntro.en: The verb covers physical wrapping, a tactical encirclement, and the absorption of a thing into an atmosphere.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个动词涵盖实体包裹、战术合围，以及事物被氛围吞没。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something rolled around an object until no edge shows.
core.cn: 核心意象：把物体层层裹住，直到看不见边缘。

branches.en: Weather and fire supply the literal covering sense.
branches.cn: 天气与火焰构成本义的覆盖。

branches.en: Tactics turn covering into a planned encirclement.
branches.cn: 战术把覆盖变为有计划的合围。

branches.en: Crowds and moods swallow outlines altogether.
branches.cn: 人群与情绪把轮廓完全吞没。

branches.en: Both hide the thing from sight.
branches.cn: 两者都让对象从视线中消失。

branches.en: Both move inward from every side at once.
branches.cn: 两者都从各方同时向内收拢。

intro.en: A Latin rolling stem is prefixed twice over in this family, yielding verbs and nouns.
intro.cn: 拉丁语表滚动的词干在本词族被反复加前缀，产出动词与名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin Volvere is to roll, involvere to wrap in, and revolvere to roll back.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 volvere 表滚动，involvere 表包裹，revolvere 表转回。

items.example: En- heads envelop.
items.exampleCN: en- 位于 envelop 开头。

items.example: Volvere is the deep stem.
items.exampleCN: volvere 是深层词干。

items.example: Involvere is the immediate source.
items.exampleCN: involvere 是直接来源。

items.example: The French form shaped English.
items.exampleCN: 法语形式塑造了英语词形。

items.example: Common with fog and flame.
items.exampleCN: 常与雾和火焰同现。

items.example: The ending forms envelopment.
items.exampleCN: 该词尾构成 envelopment。

items.example: The noun took the French infinitive shape.
items.exampleCN: 名词采用法语不定式形式。

items.example: A sibling borrowing of the stem.
items.exampleCN: 同一词干的另一借入形式。

items.example: Re- repeats the rolling.
items.exampleCN: re- 让滚动重复。

definition_zh: 电离；电离作用；电离度（溶液中分子离解成离子的比例）
definition_en: the process in which neutral atoms or molecules lose or gain electrons and become electrically charged particles
core_image: 一支充了气体的玻璃管里，一束射线穿过，原本成对绕行的电子被撞脱，正负粒子各自向两端电极奔去
scene: 实验员把一束射线打进密闭的玻璃管，管里原本不导电的气体忽然亮起并通了电。 Ionization of the gas turns an insulator into a conductor.
sceneCN: 这里 ionization 指中性原子或分子被夺走电子、变成带电粒子的过程（第 1 个义项：中性粒子生成离子的转变）；句意：气体的电离使它从绝缘体变成导体。图中可辨识物件：玻璃管、两端电极、飞散的电子、淡紫色辉光。

pos.zh: 电离；电离作用；电离度

derivatives.zh: 由 ion 加动词后缀构成，义为「使成为离子」
由 ionize 加表示已然的形容词后缀构成，义为「已电离的」
由 ionize 加表示进行的分词后缀构成，义为「致电离的」
由 ionize 加表示施动者的后缀构成，义为「产生离子的装置」

senses.title: Birth of charged particles
senses.definition: the process by which a neutral atom or molecule becomes an ion
senses.definitionCN: 中性原子或分子转变为离子的过程
senses.example: Ionization of the gas turns an insulator into a conductor.
senses.exampleCN: 气体的电离使它从绝缘体变成导体。
senses.why: The noun names the making of an ion and adds an ending that marks an action or process, so the word points to the event rather than to the particle produced.
senses.whyCN: 这个词由表示离子的名词加表示「动作、过程」的名词后缀构成，因此指向事件本身，而不是产物。

senses.title: Gas made able to carry current
senses.titleCN: 气体被电离后能够导电
senses.definition: the change that lets a gas, normally an insulator, carry an electric current
senses.definitionCN: 使通常绝缘的气体能够承载电流的变化
senses.example: Once ionization begins, the discharge tube carries a steady current.
senses.exampleCN: 一旦开始电离，放电管就能通过稳定电流。
senses.why: A gas conducts only when it holds free charges, so the same event that creates ions is described by what it makes possible.
senses.whyCN: 气体只有带着自由电荷才能导电，因此同一事件也从「它使什么成为可能」这一角度被命名。

senses.title: Share of molecules that have split
senses.titleCN: 已离解分子所占的比例
senses.definition: the fraction of the molecules in a solution that have separated into ions
senses.definitionCN: 溶液中已经离解为离子的分子所占的比例
senses.example: In a weak acid the degree of ionization stays small.
senses.exampleCN: 在弱酸中，电离度始终很小。
senses.why: The process is not all-or-nothing, so the word also measures how far the process has gone in a given sample.
senses.whyCN: 电离并非全有全无，因此这个词也用来衡量某一具体样品中过程进行到了什么程度。

senses.title: Energy needed to strip an electron
senses.titleCN: 剥离一个电子所需的能量
senses.definition: the minimum energy required to remove an electron from an atom or molecule
senses.definitionCN: 从原子或分子中移走一个电子所需的最小能量
senses.example: Each element has a characteristic ionization energy.
senses.exampleCN: 每种元素都有其特征性的电离能。
senses.why: Removing an electron is the first step of ionization, and the energy that step costs is named by the event it enables.
senses.whyCN: 移走电子是电离的第一步，这一步要付出的能量就借用它所促成的事件来命名。

senses.title: Electron ionization in an instrument
senses.definition: the technique of knocking electrons out of sample molecules with a beam of electrons inside a mass spectrometer
senses.definitionCN: 在质谱仪内用电子束把样品分子打出电子的技术
senses.example: Electron ionization fragments the sample into charged pieces.
senses.exampleCN: 电子电离把样品打碎成带电碎片。
senses.why: The general event is narrowed to one instrument, where the electrons are removed deliberately so the fragments can be weighed.
senses.whyCN: 一般过程被收窄到某种仪器里：那里有意打掉电子，好让碎片能被称量。

senses.title: Water ionizing itself
senses.definition: the slight, spontaneous separation of water molecules into charged parts without any added acid or base
senses.definitionCN: 不加酸或碱时，水分子自发地少量分离成带电部分
senses.example: Even pure water undergoes slight self-ionization.
senses.exampleCN: 即使纯水也会发生轻微的自电离。
senses.why: Water can act as its own source of ions, so the word is used without any external agent doing the stripping.
senses.whyCN: 水可以自己充当离子来源，因此这里不需要任何外部作用者来剥离电子。

senses.title: Ionization recorded as a signal
senses.definition: the ionization produced inside a detector, which appears as an electrical pulse or current
senses.definitionCN: 在探测器内部产生的电离，以电脉冲或电流的形式呈现
senses.example: Radiation entering the chamber produces ionization that the circuit records.
senses.exampleCN: 进入电离室的辐射产生的电离会被电路记录下来。
senses.why: Here the event is valued for its by-product: each ion pair becomes a countable electrical sign of radiation passing through.
senses.whyCN: 这里看重的是它的副产品：每一对离子都变成辐射经过的可计数电信号。

senses.title: Ionization high in the atmosphere
senses.definition: the charging of air molecules far above the ground by cosmic rays and solar radiation
senses.definitionCN: 高空空气分子被宇宙射线与太阳辐射充电的过程
senses.example: Cosmic rays cause ionization high above the ground.
senses.exampleCN: 宇宙射线在高空造成电离。
senses.why: The same physical event is scaled up from a laboratory tube to a whole layer of air, where the stripping agent is natural radiation.
senses.whyCN: 同一物理事件从实验室的玻璃管放大到整层空气，只是剥离电子的主角换成了天然辐射。

intro.en: Ionization is built on ion, a word coined in 1834 from a Greek participle meaning 'going', plus the action ending -ization. The dates of the derived English words are approximate.
intro.cn: ionization 由 ion 加表示动作的名词后缀构成，而 ion 是 1834 年借希腊语一个意为「行走的」分词所造的新词；英语派生词的具体年代为约数。

items.en: The Greek verb ienai meant 'to go', and its neuter participle ion named 'that which goes'; the image is a thing in motion.
items.cn: 希腊语动词 ienai 意为「走、行进」，其中性分词 ion 指「行走之物」；画面是一个在移动的东西。

items.en: Faraday, advised by Whewell, took ion for the charged particles that travel to the electrodes during electrolysis, because they appear to move through the liquid.
items.cn: 法拉第在惠威尔的建议下，用 ion 指电解时奔向电极的带电粒子，因为它们看上去是在液体中移动。

items.en: English adopted ion as the ordinary noun for an atom or molecule that carries an electric charge.
items.cn: 英语把 ion 收作普通名词，指带电荷的原子或分子。

items.en: As electrolysis and gas discharge were studied, speakers formed the verb ionize and the noun ionization from ion, using the verb and action endings already available in English.
items.cn: 随着电解与气体放电研究推进，人们用英语中现成的动词后缀与动作名词后缀，从 ion 造出动词 ionize 与名词 ionization。

items.en: Improved vacuum pumps and radiation detectors carried the word into mass spectrometry, nuclear physics and atmospheric science, where the same event is made, measured or merely observed.
items.cn: 真空泵与辐射探测器的改良把该词带入质谱、核物理与大气科学，同一事件在那里或被制造、或被测量、或只是被观察到。

items.en: Source uncertain for the pre-Greek root: the deeper origin of ienai is not established, and older forms sometimes quoted for it are reconstructions rather than attested words.
items.cn: 希腊语之前的词根来源不确定：ienai 更早的来源尚未确立，有时被引用的更古老形式属于重构形式，而非有文献的形式。

note.en: The first group shares the ion stem; the second group names neighbouring events that also leave charged particles behind.
note.cn: 第一组共享 ion 词干；第二组是同样留下带电粒子的相邻过程。

entries.definition: The charged atom or molecule that ionization produces; the noun names the result, not the process.
entries.definitionCN: 电离所产生的带电原子或分子；这个名词指结果，不指过程。

entries.definition: To produce ions from neutral matter; it is the action behind the noun ionization.
entries.definitionCN: 从中性物质产生离子；它就是 ionization 背后的动作。

entries.definition: An apparatus that ionizes air; the ending marks an agent, so it names a machine.
entries.definitionCN: 使空气电离的装置；后缀标示施动者，因此它指机器。

entries.definition: A detector in which ionization is the working signal; here the word is a modifier inside a fixed term.
entries.definitionCN: 以电离作为工作信号的探测器；这里该词是固定术语里的修饰成分。

entries.definition: The separation of a molecule into smaller pieces, often ions; it stresses the breaking of a bond rather than the birth of charge.
entries.definitionCN: 分子分离成更小部分，常为离子；它强调化学键断开，而不是电荷产生。

entries.definition: A process in which an electric current forces chemical change; ionization supplies the carriers that make it work.
entries.definitionCN: 电流迫使化学变化发生的过程；电离提供使其运作的载流子。

entries.definition: The flow of current through an ionized gas, seen as glow or spark; it is the visible consequence of ionization.
entries.definitionCN: 电流通过被电离气体的现象，表现为辉光或火花；它是电离可见的后果。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real terms and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实术语与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: ion plus the action ending -ization: the noun is the event of making ions.
normal.cn: ion 加表示动作的名词后缀：这个名词就是「制造离子」这件事。

normal.en: The family runs ion, ionize, ionized, ionizing, ionizer and ionization.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 ion、ionize、ionized、ionizing、ionizer 与 ionization。

normal.en: Fixed terms mark the measured side: ionization energy, degree of ionization, ionization chamber.
normal.cn: 固定术语标出可测量的一面：电离能、电离度、电离室。

normal.en: Faraday chose the Greek word for 'going' because the charged pieces seem to walk toward the poles.
normal.cn: 法拉第选用了希腊语「行走」一词，因为带电碎片看上去正走向两极。

normal.en: A discharge tube is the standard picture: dark gas, a beam, then a glowing path of current.
normal.cn: 放电管是标准画面：暗气体、一束射线，然后一条发亮的通电路径。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd at a gate suddenly splitting into two streams that head for opposite exits.
abstract.cn: 想象门口的人群忽然分成两股，朝相反的两个出口走去。

abstract.en: Picture a locked door that opens only when one small pin is pulled out of its hinge.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇锁住的门，只因为从铰链里抽走一枚小销子就开了。

abstract.en: Picture a choir that was one voice until a single note split it into two answering parts.
abstract.cn: 想象一个合唱队原本只有一个声音，一个音符把它分成互相应答的两部。

examples.en: The detector relies on ionization produced by passing particles.
examples.cn: 该探测器依靠粒子经过时产生的电离工作。

examples.en: Raising the temperature increased the degree of ionization in the vapour.
examples.cn: 升高温度提高了蒸气中的电离度。

examples.en: Textbooks list the ionization energies of the elements in a table.
examples.cn: 教科书用一张表列出各元素的电离能。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ion（离子）+ 化」——把中性粒子化成带电离子

root: 英语 ion（离子，1834 年据希腊语 ienai「行走」的中性分词所造）+ 表示动作的名词后缀；希腊语更早的词根来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one event: a neutral particle is stripped of charge, and the same event is then read as conductivity, as a measured share, as an energy cost, as an instrument technique, as water acting on itself, as a detector signal, and as a natural process in the sky.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕同一件事：中性粒子被剥去电荷；同一件事随后被读成导电能力、被量化的比例、能量代价、仪器手段、水对自身的作用、探测器信号，以及天空中的自然过程。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a beam crossing a sealed tube, knocking electrons loose so that charged pieces fly to opposite poles.
core.cn: 核心意象：一束射线穿过密闭管，把电子撞脱，带电碎片飞向相反的两极。

branches.en: THE EVENT ITSELF: a neutral particle becomes charged, which is the gesture every other sense repeats.
branches.cn: 事件本身：中性粒子变成带电粒子，这是其余各义项反复重演的那个动作。

branches.en: WHAT IT ENABLES AND HOW FAR IT GOES: the gas can carry current, and the process can be reported as a proportion.
branches.cn: 它促成了什么、又进行到哪一步：气体因此能导电，过程也能被报成一个比例。

branches.en: THE PRICE OF THE FIRST STEP: stripping one electron has a fixed energy cost named after the event.
branches.cn: 第一步的代价：剥走一个电子要付出固定能量，这笔能量便以该事件命名。

branches.en: WHO DOES THE STRIPPING: an electron beam in a machine, or water molecules acting on themselves.
branches.cn: 谁来完成剥离：机器里的电子束，或水分子对自身下手。

branches.en: WHERE THE EVENT IS READ: the ion pairs become a signal in a chamber, or a natural charge layer high in the air.
branches.cn: 事件在哪里被读取：离子对在电离室里变成信号，或在高空形成天然带电层。

intro.en: Ionization is a Greek-rooted noun with two layers of endings, and both layers also build other English words.
intro.cn: ionization 是一个希腊语词根的名词，带着两层词尾，这两层词尾也参与构成其他英语词。

latinIntro.en: The root is Greek, not Latin; Latin contributes only the verb ending that reached English through French, so no Latin cognate of the root is listed.
latinIntro.cn: 词根来自希腊语而非拉丁语；拉丁语只贡献了经法语进入英语的动词词尾，因此不列出该词根的拉丁同族词。

items.example: The particle itself is the noun ion.
items.exampleCN: 粒子本身就叫 ion。

items.structure: verb-forming ending, through French from Greek
items.example: The ending turns the noun into an action.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾把名词变成动作。

items.structure: action noun ending, from the verb ending plus a noun ending
items.meaning: the process of making or becoming
items.example: The longer ending names the process rather than the act.
items.exampleCN: 较长的词尾命名过程而不是单次动作。

items.example: The beam ionizes the gas in the tube.
items.exampleCN: 射束使管中的气体电离。

items.structure: ionize plus the action noun ending
items.example: Ionization of the gas turns it into a conductor.
items.exampleCN: 气体的电离使它成为导体。

items.example: The ionized layer reflects radio waves.
items.exampleCN: 已电离的那一层会反射无线电波。

items.example: Ionizing radiation is handled behind shielding.
items.exampleCN: 致电离辐射要在屏蔽层后操作。

items.example: The ionizer charges the air in the room.
items.exampleCN: 这台离子发生器使室内空气带电。

derivatives.zh: 由 ion 加动词词尾构成，义为「使成为离子」
由 ionize 加已然词尾构成，义为「已电离的」
由 ionize 加进行词尾构成，义为「致电离的」
由 ionize 加施动词尾构成，义为「离子发生器」

definition_zh: 核实；验证；查证；确认；证明为真；身份核验；合规审查；（哲学）证实原则
definition_en: the act of checking or proving that something is true, accurate, or genuine
core_image: 一枚印章落在核对过的文件末尾，旁边是逐条打勾的清单
scene: 审核员把每一张发票与合同逐条对照，确认金额和日期都能对上，才在末页盖章。 Before payment, the clerk carried out a careful verification of every invoice against the contract.
sceneCN: 这里指逐条核对材料是否真实、准确（第 1 个义项：核实、查证）；句意为付款前职员把每张发票与合同仔细核对了一遍。场景图取象：核对完的文件末尾落下一枚印章。

pos.zh: 核实；验证；查证（不可数，指过程时多用单数）
证明为真的证据或确认结论
身份、证件、账户的核验
（哲学）证实原则；证实主义的核心概念

derivatives.zh: 核实；证实（由「真」与「做」两个拉丁词根合成，字面即「使之成真」）
可核实的（加表示「能够被……」的形容词后缀，指可以被查证）
可核实性（在形容词后加表示「性质」的名词后缀）
核验者；验证程序（加表示「施动者」的名词后缀）
已核实的；经确认的（动词过去分词转为形容词，指核验已经完成）
证实主义（在 verification 后加表示「学说」的后缀，指以能否证实判断意义的主张）

senses.title: The act of checking
senses.definition: the act of checking whether a statement, figure or account is true and accurate
senses.definitionCN: 检查某一说法、数字或账目是否真实准确的行为
senses.example: Verification of the figures took three days.
senses.exampleCN: 核对这些数字花了三天。
senses.why: The word joins 'true' and 'make', so the act is making sure a claim really is true.
senses.whyCN: 这个词把「真」与「做」合在一起，动作就是确保某个说法确实为真。

senses.title: Formal confirmation
senses.definition: official confirmation that a document, claim or record meets a required standard
senses.definitionCN: 官方确认某份文件、声明或记录达到了规定标准
senses.example: The certificate requires verification by a public notary.
senses.exampleCN: 这份证书需要由公证人正式确认。
senses.why: Institutions need a stamp as well as a check, and the word covers both the check and the resulting confirmation.
senses.whyCN: 机构既要查也要盖章，这个词同时涵盖查验与由此得到的确认。

senses.title: Evidence that proves
senses.definition: a piece of evidence or a statement that establishes something as true
senses.definitionCN: 能证明某事为真的证据或说法
senses.example: His notes served as verification of the claim.
senses.exampleCN: 他的笔记成了这一说法的凭据。
senses.why: The noun can name the proof itself, not only the act of producing it.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词也能指证据本身，而不只是取得证据的动作。

senses.title: Checking who you are
senses.definition: the process of confirming a person's identity, account or credentials before granting access
senses.definitionCN: 在给予权限之前确认某人身份、账户或凭证的程序
senses.example: Two-step verification blocked the stolen password.
senses.exampleCN: 两步核验挡住了被盗的密码。
senses.why: Digital accounts made this the everyday sense: a second check that the person is who the password says.
senses.whyCN: 数字账户使这一义项成为日常用法：再查一次，看人是否真如密码所称。

senses.title: Test against reality
senses.definition: confirmation of a scientific claim by independent observation, measurement or experiment
senses.definitionCN: 通过独立观察、测量或实验来确认某一科学主张
senses.example: Independent verification is the price of a published result.
senses.exampleCN: 独立验证是一项结果得以发表的代价。
senses.why: Science separates the claim from the claimant by asking another laboratory to check it.
senses.whyCN: 科学把主张与主张者分开，办法是让另一个实验室去查。

senses.title: Proof that software obeys its spec
senses.definition: the process of showing that a program or system has been built according to its stated requirements
senses.definitionCN: 证明某个程序或系统是按其声明的需求建成的过程
senses.example: Verification caught the error before the release.
senses.exampleCN: 验证在发布前抓住了这个错误。
senses.why: Engineering distinguishes building the thing right from building the right thing, and calls the first verification.
senses.whyCN: 工程学把「把东西做对」与「做对的东西」分开，前者称为验证。

senses.title: Audit of accounts
senses.definition: a formal audit of records, accounts or compliance with rules
senses.definitionCN: 对记录、账目或规则遵守情况的正式审查
senses.example: The agency ordered verification of the charity's spending.
senses.exampleCN: 主管机构下令核查该慈善机构的开支。
senses.why: Public money brings a legal duty to check, and the word acquired an administrative weight.
senses.whyCN: 公共资金带来核对的法定义务，这个词因此带上行政分量。

senses.title: Fact-checking before print
senses.definition: the editorial process of checking names, dates and quotations before publication
senses.definitionCN: 发表前核对人名、日期与引文的编辑程序
senses.example: The magazine's verification desk flagged two dates.
senses.exampleCN: 杂志的核实台标出了两个日期问题。
senses.why: Publishing houses built a desk for this work, and the word named both the desk and its task.
senses.whyCN: 出版社为此设了专岗，这个词既指这个岗位，也指它的工作。

senses.title: The verification principle
senses.definition: the philosophical rule that a statement is meaningful only if it can be checked by experience
senses.definitionCN: 一种哲学主张：一个陈述只有能被经验检验才有意义
senses.example: The verification principle turned out to be too strict for its own rule.
senses.exampleCN: 证实原则对自己那条规则来说过于严格。
senses.why: Early twentieth-century philosophy tried to make meaning a testable property, and gave the word this narrow sense.
senses.whyCN: 二十世纪初的哲学想把意义变成可检验的属性，于是给了这个词一个狭窄的义项。

intro.en: Verification is built from the Latin verus 'true' and facere 'to make', through Medieval Latin verificare. The chain is well documented and the only uncertain point is the exact date of its English entry.
intro.cn: verification 由拉丁语 verus「真」与 facere「做」构成，经由中世纪拉丁语 verificare 而来。词源链记录充分，唯一不确定的是它进入英语的确切年代。

items.en: Verus meant true or genuine, and it stands behind verity, veracity and the English word very.
items.cn: verus 意为真实的、真正的，还构成 verity、veracity 以及英语的 very。

items.en: The verb facere, to make or do, supplies the second half of the compound and the -fication ending.
items.cn: 动词 facere 意为做、造，提供复合词的后半与 -fication 这一词尾。

items.en: Verificare meant to make true or to prove true, a word of the schools rather than of everyday speech.
items.cn: verificare 意为使之成真或证明为真，是学院用语而非日常口语。

items.en: The noun entered English in the late Middle Ages, first in learned and legal writing; the exact date is uncertain.
items.cn: 这个名词在中世纪晚期进入英语，最早见于学术与法律文本；确切年代不确定。

items.en: From the seventeenth century it spread into experiment and jurisprudence, where a claim must be checked by evidence.
items.cn: 十七世纪以后，它扩展到实验与法学领域，那里主张必须靠证据核查。

items.en: In the last decades it became a household word through codes, passwords and two-step checks.
items.cn: 近几十年，它靠验证码、密码与两步核验成了家常词汇。

note.en: The first group shares the true-making root or merely looks close; the second group contains the neighbouring checks that are often confused with verification.
note.cn: 第一组或共享「使真」词根，或只是字形相近；第二组是常与「验证」混淆的邻近概念。

entries.definition: The verb behind the noun: to check or prove that something is true.
entries.definitionCN: 名词背后的动词：核查或证明某事为真。

entries.definition: Truthfulness, especially of a person or account; it shares verus but not facere.
entries.definitionCN: 真实性、诚实，尤指人或陈述；共享「真」词根，不含「做」。

entries.definition: An old word for truth itself, built on the same Latin adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 指真理本身的古词，由同一个拉丁形容词构成。

entries.definition: The art of turning prose into verse; it looks close but comes from versus, a turning of the plough.
entries.definitionCN: 把散文写成诗句的技艺；字形相近，却来自「犁沟转向」之意的 versus。

entries.definition: Abusive speech that lowers someone's name; its first element means cheap or base.
entries.definitionCN: 贬损他人名誉的辱骂；其前一部分意为低贱。

entries.definition: Checking that a system meets the user's real need, as opposed to its written specification.
entries.definitionCN: 检查系统是否满足使用者的真实需要，与书面规格相对。

entries.definition: A statement or act that makes something formally certain.
entries.definitionCN: 使某事在形式上确定的说法或举动。

entries.definition: Proving that a person or object is genuine, especially in computing.
entries.definitionCN: 证明人或物为真品，尤用于计算机领域。

entries.definition: Formal granting of a certificate after an authority has checked a standard.
entries.definitionCN: 主管机构查过标准后正式发给证书。

entries.definition: The journalistic routine of confirming details before publication.
entries.definitionCN: 发表前核对细节的新闻例行工作。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real true-making root, the real derivative family and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的「使真」词根、真实派生词族与真实固定搭配。

normal.en: Verus is true and facere is make, so verification is literally the making true of a claim.
normal.cn: 前者为真，后者为做，合起来字面就是使一个说法成真。

normal.en: The same true root gives verity and veracity, while the make root gives -fication in dozens of words.
normal.cn: 同一个「真」词根给出 verity 与 veracity，「做」词根则在许多词里留下 -fication 词尾。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the uses: identity verification, independent verification, verification code.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出用法：身份核验、独立核实、验证码。

normal.en: The verb is verify, the adjective verifiable, the person verifier.
normal.cn: 动词是 verify，形容词是可核实的，执行者是核验者。

normal.en: A verified document carries a stamp; a verification is the check that earns the stamp.
normal.cn: 已核实的文件带着印章，核验就是挣来这枚印章的检查。

abstract.en: Verification is distrust put to work in an orderly way.
abstract.cn: 核验是把不信任按规矩使出来。

abstract.en: It does not create truth; it only refuses to accept a claim until the claim can be checked.
abstract.cn: 它并不制造真理，只是在说法可被核对之前拒绝接受它。

abstract.en: A society that stops verifying slowly loses the difference between a claim and a fact.
abstract.cn: 一个不再核验的社会，会慢慢失去主张与事实之间的区别。

examples.en: Verification of the sample took longer than the test itself.
examples.cn: 样本核验比测试本身花的时间还长。

examples.en: The bank asks for a second verification before large transfers.
examples.cn: 大额转账前银行要求再做一次核验。

examples.en: Independent verification is what turns an announcement into a result.
examples.cn: 独立验证才能把一则宣告变成一个结果。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「维瑞菲克申」——把「真」做出来，逐条打勾盖章：核实、验证

root: 中世纪拉丁语 verificare「使之成真、证明为真」← 拉丁语 verus「真」＋ facere「做、造」；verus 另构成 verity、veracity 与 very，facere 构成 -fication 系列。进入英语的确切年代不确定，义项扩展至科学、法律与数字身份。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow the same act: a check, a formal confirmation, the proof itself, an identity check, a test against reality, proof of a specification, an audit, editorial fact-checking, and a philosophical principle.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项跟着同一个动作：核对、正式确认、凭据本身、身份核验、用事实检验、对规格的证明、账目审查、刊前核实，以及一条哲学原则。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a checked list with ticks beside every line, and a stamp waiting at the end.
core.cn: 核心意象：每行都打了勾的清单，末尾等着落下一枚印章。

branches.en: THE CHECK AND ITS PROOF: the act of testing a claim, and the evidence that the test produced.
branches.cn: 检查及其凭据：检验主张的动作，以及检验得出的证据。

branches.en: THE OFFICIAL SEAL: confirmation by an authority, and the audit that must come before it.
branches.cn: 官方印章：主管者的确认，以及确认之前必须做的审查。

branches.en: THE IDENTITY CHECK: the second step that proves a person is who the account says.
branches.cn: 身份核验：证明人如其账户所称的第二步。

branches.en: THE TEST OF A CLAIM: independent experiment, a program checked against its specification, and a page checked before print.
branches.cn: 对主张的检验：独立实验、按规格检查的程序，以及付印前核对过的稿件。

branches.en: THE PRINCIPLE: meaning itself is said to require a possible check.
branches.cn: 那条原则：意义本身被要求可以被检验。

intro.en: Verification is a compound of two productive Latin pieces, and its endings still build abstract nouns in English.
intro.cn: verification 由两个能产的拉丁构件合成，其词尾在英语中仍能造抽象名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin verus and facere are the two sources; the noun ending came through Medieval Latin -ficatio.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 verus 与 facere 是两个来源，名词词尾经由中世纪拉丁语的 -ficatio 而来。

items.example: The noun names both the act and its outcome.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词既指动作，也指结果。

items.example: It also stands behind verity and very.
items.exampleCN: 它还构成 verity 与 very。

items.example: It is the source of the -fy and -fication endings.
items.exampleCN: 它是 -fy 与 -fication 词尾的来源。

items.example: It builds classification, simplification and purification.
items.exampleCN: 它构成分类、简化与提纯等词。

items.example: It builds verify, clarify and amplify.
items.exampleCN: 它构成核实、澄清与放大等动词。

items.example: The adjective sets the standard for a good claim.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词为好的主张立下标准。

items.meaning: one who or that which checks
items.example: The ending marks the person or the tool.
items.exampleCN: 词尾标出人或工具。

items.example: The abstract noun names a property rather than an act.
items.exampleCN: 这个抽象名词指属性而非动作。

latinEntries.meaning: to make true; to prove true
latinEntries.example: Medieval Latin verificare means to make true.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 中世纪拉丁语 verificare 意为使之为真。

latinEntries.example: Latin verus means true, and gives veracity and verdict.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语 verus 意为真的，并给出 veracity 与 verdict。

latinEntries.structure: Latin verb facere (fac-, factum; to make)
latinEntries.example: Latin facere means to make or do.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语 facere 意为做、造。

definition_zh: 为实验、演示或专用操作设计一整套装置的工作，包括支架、气路、防护与人机操作
definition_en: the work of designing a complete setup for an experiment, demonstration or specialised operation, including frame, flow paths, safety and controls
core_image: 空台面上先摆出支架、气路与防护罩的位置，再逐件画尺寸，最后合成一张装配图
scene: 实验台前，工程师把支架、气路与防护罩逐件摆开，先量尺寸再画装配图。 The team revised the apparatus design after the first trial failed.
sceneCN: 这里指整套装置的方案设计（第 1 个义项：为实验、演示或专用操作设计一整套装置的工作）；句意：首次试验失败后，团队修改了装置设计。

pos.zh: 装置设计；器械设计

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁语「准备」的结果名词借入，义为「装置」
由拉丁语「标出」经法语进入英语，义为「设计」
由「设计」加人称词尾构成，义为「设计师」
由拉丁语「标出」构成，义为「指定」
由拉丁语「准备」经法语进入英语，义为「准备」
由拉丁语「一起收集」进入英语，义为「装配、组件」

senses.title: Designing the whole setup
senses.definition: the work of planning every part of a setup so that it performs one intended operation
senses.definitionCN: 规划一套装置的所有部件，使它们完成一项预期操作的工作
senses.example: Good apparatus design starts from the operation, not from the parts.
senses.exampleCN: 良好的装置设计从操作出发，而不是从零件出发。
senses.why: Apparatus names the assembled set and design names the planning, so the phrase is planning the whole set.
senses.whyCN: 「装置」指组装好的一套，「设计」指规划，因此这个词组就是规划整套装置。

senses.title: Frame and support
senses.definition: the design of the bench, frame, clamps and mounts that hold every part in place
senses.definitionCN: 设计把每个部件固定住的工作台、框架、夹具与支座
senses.example: The apparatus design used an aluminium frame to keep the optics steady.
senses.exampleCN: 装置设计用铝型材框架让光学件保持稳定。
senses.why: Nothing can be measured if it moves, so the supporting frame is the first structural decision.
senses.whyCN: 部件一动就测不准，因此支承框架是第一个结构决定。

senses.title: Gas and fluid paths
senses.definition: the layout of tubes, valves, seals and reservoirs that carry gas or liquid
senses.definitionCN: 输送气体或液体的管路、阀门、密封与储罐布置
senses.example: The apparatus design put the regulator upstream of every valve.
senses.exampleCN: 装置设计把调节器放在每个阀门的上游。
senses.why: Many setups exist to move a fluid, and the path of that fluid shapes the whole layout.
senses.whyCN: 许多装置的存在就是为了输送流体，而流体的路径决定整体布置。

senses.title: Safety and containment
senses.definition: the guards, shields, vents and interlocks that keep an experiment from harming people
senses.definitionCN: 防止实验伤人的护罩、屏蔽、泄放口与联锁
senses.example: The apparatus design added a shield after the first pressure spike.
senses.exampleCN: 第一次压力骤升之后，装置设计增加了一层护罩。
senses.why: A setup concentrates energy and chemicals, so its design must decide where that energy may go.
senses.whyCN: 装置把能量与化学品集中起来，因此其设计必须决定能量允许去哪里。

senses.title: Controls and operator interface
senses.definition: the placement of switches, gauges and touch points so that a person can run the setup safely
senses.definitionCN: 安排开关、仪表与操作点，使人能安全运行装置
senses.example: The apparatus design moved the emergency stop within arm's reach.
senses.exampleCN: 装置设计把急停按钮移到伸手可及处。
senses.why: A setup is run by hands, so the layout of controls is part of its design, not an afterthought.
senses.whyCN: 装置由人手操作，因此控制布局是其设计的一部分，而不是事后补的。

senses.title: Serviceability and assembly
senses.definition: the design of joints, access panels and part numbering so the setup can be built and repaired
senses.definitionCN: 设计接头、检修口与零件编号，使装置能被组装与修理
senses.example: The apparatus design let one person change the filter in a minute.
senses.exampleCN: 装置设计让一个人一分钟就能换掉滤芯。
senses.why: A bench setup is taken apart as often as it is used, so ease of service belongs in the design.
senses.whyCN: 台面装置被拆开的次数不亚于使用次数，因此易维护也应纳入设计。

senses.title: Teaching demonstration setups
senses.definition: the design of simple visible equipment that shows a principle to a class
senses.definitionCN: 设计简单可见、能向课堂展示某一原理的器材
senses.example: The apparatus design for the lecture used only transparent parts.
senses.exampleCN: 这堂讲座的装置设计只用了透明部件。
senses.why: When the purpose is to show rather than to measure, visibility becomes the leading design rule.
senses.whyCN: 当目的是展示而非测量时，可见性就成了首要设计规则。

senses.title: Verification and trial runs
senses.definition: the testing, leak checking and revision that follows a first design
senses.definitionCN: 首版设计之后的试验、查漏与改版
senses.example: The apparatus design was signed off only after three trial runs.
senses.exampleCN: 装置设计在三次试运行之后才获批准。
senses.why: A design for a setup is a claim about behaviour, and only a trial can confirm it.
senses.whyCN: 装置设计是关于行为的断言，只有试运行才能证实它。

intro.en: Apparatus design joins a Latin result noun for a prepared set with a Latin-rooted verb for marking out a plan.
intro.cn: 「装置设计」把一个拉丁语中表示「备好的一套」的结果名词，与一个拉丁语词根、表示「标出计划」的动词组合。

items.en: Parare meant to prepare or make ready; it is the direct Latin source, while its deeper origin is uncertain and the link to a producing root is only a suggestion.
items.cn: 这个拉丁语动词指准备、备好；它是本词的直接拉丁语来源，其更早来源存疑，与表示「产出」之古词根的关联仅为推测。

items.en: Apparatus named the prepared set itself, and English borrowed the whole Latin form in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 这个拉丁语名词指备好的一套本身，英语在十七世纪整体借入该拉丁形式。

items.en: Signum meant a mark or sign; designare meant to mark out, and English design came through French and Italian.
items.cn: 这个拉丁语名词指标记或符号；相应动词表示标出，英语的「设计」经法语与意大利语进入。

items.en: As experimental science built custom benches, planning the whole setup became a distinct task with drawings and trials.
items.cn: 随着实验科学搭起定制台架，规划整套装置成为一项有图纸与试验的独立任务。

items.en: Pressure, heat and chemicals forced designers to treat guards and interlocks as part of the plan.
items.cn: 压力、高温与化学品迫使设计者把护罩与联锁纳入方案。

items.era: MODERN PHRASE · FIRST RECORD DATE UNCERTAIN
items.en: The two words became a fixed phrase for the engineering of a complete experimental or industrial setup; the exact year of first record is uncertain.
items.cn: 这两个词固定成词组，指完整实验或工业装置的工程工作；具体首见年代不确定。

note.en: The first group shares the prepare root; the second group names adjacent design tasks.
note.cn: 第一组共享「准备」词根；第二组是相邻的设计任务。

entries.definition: The assembled set itself; the target is the plan for it.
entries.definitionCN: 组装好的装置本身；目标词是它的方案。

entries.definition: To make ready; the root action behind apparatus.
entries.definitionCN: 准备；装置背后的词根动作。

entries.definition: A plan or the act of planning.
entries.definitionCN: 计划或规划行为。

entries.definition: The person who makes the plan.
entries.definitionCN: 制定方案的人。

entries.definition: Designing a purchased set of machines; the target is usually a bespoke lab setup.
entries.definitionCN: 设计采购来的成套机器；目标词通常指定制的实验装置。

entries.definition: Designing the holding devices for manufacturing; narrower than a whole apparatus.
entries.definitionCN: 设计制造用的夹持装置；比整套装置窄。

entries.definition: Designing a temporary test setup; the target suggests a more permanent, finished arrangement.
entries.definitionCN: 设计临时试验台；目标词暗示更永久、更完整的布置。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes and real fixed terms, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分与真实固定搭配，而不是编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Apparatus is the prepared set; design is the plan marked out in advance.
normal.cn: 装置是备好的一套，设计是预先标出的方案。

normal.en: The family runs apparatus, prepare, design, designer, designate.
normal.cn: 同族词包括装置、准备、设计、设计师、指定。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark it: apparatus design review, apparatus design drawing.
normal.cn: 固定搭配可标记它：装置设计评审、装置设计图。

normal.en: Its four layers are frame, flow path, safety and controls.
normal.cn: 它的四层是框架、流路、安全与控制。

normal.en: Its proof is a trial run with no leak and no surprise.
normal.cn: 它的证明是一次无泄漏、无意外的试运行。

abstract.en: Picture a table that holds every glass part exactly still while hands work around it.
abstract.cn: 想象一张桌子，在所有手围绕它操作时把每个玻璃件稳稳固定。

abstract.en: Picture a cage that lets heat out but keeps fingers in.
abstract.cn: 想象一个只放热、不放手指进来的罩子。

abstract.en: Picture a switch placed where a frightened hand will find it first.
abstract.cn: 想象一个开关放在惊慌的手最先能摸到的地方。

examples.en: The apparatus design had to fit through a standard doorway.
examples.cn: 这套装置设计必须能通过一扇标准门。

examples.en: Safety review stopped the apparatus design until the vent was moved.
examples.cn: 安全评审叫停了装置设计，直到泄放口被移位。

examples.en: Students compare two apparatus designs for the same reaction.
examples.cn: 学生们比较同一反应的两种装置设计。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「装置」+「设计」——把一整套器械先在纸上摆稳

root: 前半源自拉丁语「备好的一套」，后半源自拉丁语「标出、规划」；两词根更早来源均存疑。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow a setup from purpose to proof: frame, flow, safety, controls, service, teaching and trial. The phrase covers the plan for a whole experimental or industrial arrangement.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项跟随一套装置从目的走到验证：框架、流路、安全、控制、维护、教学与试运行。这个词组覆盖完整实验或工业装置的方案。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an empty bench where the places of frame, tubes, shield and switch are marked before anything is built.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张空台面，在动手之前先标出框架、管路、护罩与开关的位置。

branches.en: THE WHOLE PLAN: every part planned around one intended operation.
branches.cn: 整体方案：围绕一项预期操作规划所有部件。

branches.en: THE SUPPORT VERSION: bench, frame, clamps and mounts.
branches.cn: 支承版本：工作台、框架、夹具与支座。

branches.en: THE FLOW VERSION: tubes, valves, seals and reservoirs.
branches.cn: 流路版本：管路、阀门、密封与储罐。

branches.en: THE SAFE-USE VERSION: guards and interlocks, plus controls within reach.
branches.cn: 安全使用版本：护罩与联锁，以及伸手可及的控制。

branches.en: THE SERVICE, TEACHING AND PROOF VERSION: access, visibility and trial runs.
branches.cn: 维护、教学与验证版本：检修口、可见性与试运行。

intro.en: One half is the Latin prepared set; the other is the Latin-rooted plan marked out with signs.
intro.cn: 一半是拉丁语「备好的一套」，另一半是拉丁语词根、用符号标出的方案。

latinIntro.en: Latin apparatus supplies the first half; signum and designare supply the second.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的「装置」提供前半，符号与「标出」提供后半。

definition_zh: 航空学；航空术（飞行器设计、制造与驾驶的科学）
definition_en: the science and art of designing, building and operating aircraft within the earth’s atmosphere
core_image: 把船开进空气里的那门学问
scene: 风洞的嗡鸣声里，学生盯着一组机翼数据不肯下课。 Aeronautics began with balloons and ended in jets.
sceneCN: 这里 aeronautics 是「航空学」（第 1 个义项：研究大气层内飞行器设计、制造与驾驶的科学）；句意为航空学始于气球而终于喷气机。核心画面是把船开进空气里的那门学问。

pos.zh: 航空学；航空术

derivatives.zh: 加 -al 构成，义为「航空的；航空学的」
加 -ic 构成，义同 aeronautical，较少用
去掉 -ics 构成，义为「航空者；气球驾驶者」

senses.title: The science of flight within the atmosphere
senses.definition: the branch of engineering and physics concerned with aircraft that fly inside the earth’s atmosphere
senses.definitionCN: 研究与在地球大气层内飞行的飞行器有关的工程与物理分支
senses.example: She earned a doctorate in aeronautics before joining the lab.
senses.exampleCN: 她在进入实验室之前取得了航空学博士学位。
senses.why: Aer means air and nautes means sailor, so aeronautics is literally sailing in air, which is exactly how balloonists first described flight.
senses.whyCN: aer 意为「空气」，nautes 意为「水手」，所以 aeronautics 字面就是「在空气中航行」，这正是早期气球驾驶者对飞行的描述。

senses.title: The practical art of flying
senses.definition: the practical skill of navigating and handling aircraft, as opposed to the theory behind them
senses.definitionCN: 驾驶与操纵飞行器的实际技艺，与其背后的理论相对
senses.example: Aeronautics in the early days was mostly courage and guesswork.
senses.exampleCN: 早期的航空术多半靠勇气与猜测。
senses.why: The sailor half of the word keeps its craft sense: a sailor is judged by handling a vessel, not by writing about it.
senses.whyCN: 词中「水手」那一半保留了技艺义：评价水手看的是操船，而不是写文章。

intro.en: Aeronautics was named when flight meant balloons: the word borrows the language of ships and lends it to the air.
intro.cn: aeronautics 得名于飞行还意味着气球的时代：这个词借来船舶的语言，再把它借给空气。

items.en: Greek aer, air, is the first root, shared with aerobic and aerolite.
items.cn: 希腊语 aer「空气」是第一个词根，与 aerobic、aerolite 共享。

items.en: Greek nautes meant sailor, from naus, ship, and it also gives nautical and astronaut.
items.cn: 希腊语 nautes 意为「水手」，源自 naus「船」，它也给出 nautical 与 astronaut。

items.en: French aéronaute was coined in the seventeen eighties for the men who ascended in the first balloons.
items.cn: 法语 aéronaute 造于十八世纪八十年代，指乘首批气球升空的人。

items.en: English aeronautics appeared in the nineteenth century as the name of the new field, on the pattern of mathematics.
items.cn: 英语 aeronautics 于十九世纪作为新学科的名称出现，构词仿照 mathematics。

items.en: In the twentieth century astronautics was formed on the same pattern for flight beyond the atmosphere, and the two are often paired.
items.cn: 二十世纪按同一模式造出 astronautics，指大气层外的飞行，两者常成对出现。

note.en: The look-alike group follows the sailor root into space and back to the sea; the near-meaning group lists neighbouring fields of flight.
note.cn: 形近组沿「水手」词根走向太空又回到海洋；近义组列出相邻的飞行领域。

entries.definition: The science of flight beyond the atmosphere.
entries.definitionCN: 大气层外飞行的科学。

entries.definition: A person who flies or navigates a balloon or aircraft.
entries.definitionCN: 驾驶气球或飞行器的人。

entries.definition: Relating to ships and sailing on the sea.
entries.definitionCN: 与船舶和海上航行有关的。

entries.definition: The activity and industry of operating aircraft.
entries.definitionCN: 运营飞行器的活动与产业。

entries.definition: The study of how air moves around solid bodies.
entries.definitionCN: 研究空气如何绕固体流动的学科。

entries.definition: The electronic systems used in aircraft.
entries.definitionCN: 飞行器所用的电子系统。

normalIntro.en: Hear the sailor inside aeronautics: naut is the same naut as nautical and astronaut.
normalIntro.cn: 听出 aeronautics 里的水手：naut 与 nautical、astronaut 中的 naut 相同。

normal.en: Aer plus naut plus -ics: the field of air-sailing.
normal.cn: aer 加 naut 加 -ics：空中航行的领域。

normal.en: Astronaut is star-sailor; aeronaut is air-sailor.
normal.cn: astronaut 是星际水手；aeronaut 是空中水手。

normal.en: Aeronautics stays inside the atmosphere; astronautics leaves it.
normal.cn: aeronautics 留在大气层内；astronautics 离开它。

normal.en: The -ics ending marks a field, as in physics and mathematics.
normal.cn: -ics 结尾标记一个学科，如 physics、mathematics。

normal.en: Aeronautical is the adjective you need before engineering or university.
normal.cn: aeronautical 是放在 engineering 或 university 前的形容词。

abstract.en: Picture a ship whose sea is the sky and whose hull is a wing.
abstract.cn: 想象一艘以天空为海、以机翼为船身的船。

abstract.en: Imagine a balloonist reading the wind the way a sailor reads a current.
abstract.cn: 想象气球驾驶者像水手读洋流那样读风。

abstract.en: Think of a discipline that began with silk bags and ended with turbine blades.
abstract.cn: 想象一门始于丝绸气囊、终于涡轮叶片的学科。

examples.en: The university founded a chair of aeronautics in nineteen twenty.
examples.cn: 那所大学于一九二年设立了航空学讲席。

examples.en: Aeronautics demands both mathematics and workshop skill.
examples.cn: 航空学既要求数学，也要求车间技艺。

examples.en: His library was full of early aeronautics manuals.
examples.cn: 他的藏书室里满是早期航空学手册。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「爱儿罗诺提克斯」——爱（aero）儿罗（nau）诺提克斯（tics），把空气当海来航行的一整套学问，就是航空学。

root: 希腊语 aer「空气」加 nautes「水手」（源自 naus「船」）构成，经法语 aéronaute 进入英语，加学科后缀 -ics 成 aeronautics，字面即「空中航行之学」。

sensesIntro.en: Both senses keep the sailor image: one is the theory of sailing in air, the other is the hands-on craft of doing it.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项都保留水手意象：一个是空中航行的理论，另一个是亲手去做的技艺。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: sailing, but with air as the sea
core.cn: 核心意象：航行，只是以空气为海

branches.en: The theory of air-sailing as a discipline.
branches.cn: 空中航行作为学科的理论。

branches.en: The hands-on skill of handling craft.
branches.cn: 操纵飞行器的动手技艺。

branches.en: Both stay inside the atmosphere.
branches.cn: 两者都留在大气层内。

branches.en: The field that pairs with astronautics.
branches.cn: 与 astronautics 成对的学科。

branches.en: The craft sense inherited from sailors.
branches.cn: 从水手那里继承的技艺义。

intro.en: Aeronautics is a Greek compound plus a field suffix, and the same recipe produced astronautics a century later.
intro.cn: aeronautics 是希腊语复合词加学科后缀，同一配方在一个世纪后造出了 astronautics。

latinIntro.en: The roots aer and nautes are Greek; Latin contributed nothing to this compound, though nautical reached English via Latin nauticus.
latinIntro.cn: 词根 aer 与 nautes 都是希腊语；这个复合词没有拉丁语贡献，尽管 nautical 是经拉丁语 nauticus 进入英语的。
