definition_zh: 星团；由引力束缚、一起运动的一群恒星
definition_en: a group of stars that are bound together by gravity and move as one system
core_image: 一小片天区里挤着几百个亮点，边缘的星像被一根看不见的绳拴住，绕着同一个中心转
scene: 望远镜里一小片天区挤着许多亮点，你说 That star cluster is bound by gravity.
sceneCN: 这里 star cluster 指「由引力束缚、共同运动的一群恒星」（第 1 个义项：受引力约束的恒星集团）；句意为那个星团被引力束缚。图中可辨识物件：密集亮点、共同的中心、引力示意弧线、望远镜视场。

pos.zh: 星团（可数；常见类型有疏散星团与球状星团）

collocations.phrase: the age of a star cluster

derivatives.zh: cluster 为英语本族名词，指一簇；star cluster 由它构成复合名词
stella + -ar：恒星的；与本词前半同源

senses.title: A group bound by gravity
senses.titleCN: 由引力束缚、共同运动的一群恒星
senses.definition: a group of stars held together by mutual gravity and moving as one system
senses.definitionCN: 一群被相互引力维系、作为同一系统运动的恒星
senses.example: That star cluster is bound by gravity.
senses.exampleCN: 那个星团被引力束缚。
senses.why: the phrase joins the object to its binding: a cluster is not merely a pattern on the sky but a physical group that stays together.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语把天体与其束缚方式并置：星团不只是天上的图案，而是真正待在一起的一群。

senses.title: An open cluster
senses.titleCN: 疏散星团：年轻、松散、多在银盘
senses.definition: a loose, relatively young group of stars, usually found in the disk of a galaxy
senses.definitionCN: 松散、相对年轻、通常位于星系盘面的恒星群
senses.example: The Pleiades is a well-known open star cluster.
senses.exampleCN: 昴星团是著名的疏散星团。
senses.why: open refers to the loose spacing: the members are bound but far apart, unlike the tight ball of a globular cluster.
senses.whyCN: open 指间距松散：成员虽受束缚却彼此相隔很远，不像球状星团那样紧成一球。

senses.title: A globular cluster
senses.titleCN: 球状星团：年老、密集、多在星系晕
senses.definition: a dense, roughly spherical group of very old stars, usually in a galaxy's halo
senses.definitionCN: 密集、近似球形、由非常古老恒星组成、通常位于星系晕中的星团
senses.example: Globular clusters orbit the galaxy far above its disk.
senses.exampleCN: 球状星团在远离盘面的高处绕星系运行。
senses.why: globular comes from Latin globulus 'little ball', and the name describes the shape seen through a telescope.
senses.whyCN: globular 出自拉丁 globulus「小球」，名字描述的是望远镜里看到的形状。

senses.title: Stars born together
senses.definition: the members of such a group, which formed from the same cloud at about the same time
senses.definitionCN: 在同一片云中、几乎同时形成的成员星
senses.example: Every star in the cluster has nearly the same age.
senses.exampleCN: 星团中每颗星的年龄几乎相同。
senses.why: because the members share a birth cloud, the cluster becomes a set of siblings with a common starting point.
senses.whyCN: 由于成员共享同一片诞生云，星团就成了一批起点相同的兄弟姐妹。

senses.title: A laboratory for stellar evolution
senses.titleCN: 研究恒星演化的天然实验室
senses.definition: a group used by astronomers as a controlled sample for studying how stars age
senses.definitionCN: 被天文学家当作研究恒星如何老去的对照样本
senses.example: A star cluster lets astronomers compare stars of one age but different masses.
senses.exampleCN: 星团让天文学家比较同龄而质量不同的恒星。
senses.why: same age and same chemistry, different mass: that is exactly the controlled comparison a laboratory would build.
senses.whyCN: 同年龄、同成分、不同质量，正是实验室会刻意构造的对照条件。

senses.title: A building block of the galaxy
senses.titleCN: 星系的组成单元与分布标记
senses.definition: a population of stars used to trace the structure and history of a galaxy
senses.definitionCN: 用来追踪星系结构与历史的一批恒星
senses.example: Old star clusters mark the halo of the Milky Way.
senses.exampleCN: 古老星团标出银河系的晕。
senses.why: clusters are bright enough to be seen far away, so they serve as tracers of a galaxy's shape.
senses.whyCN: 星团足够亮，能在远处被看见，因此可作星系形状的示踪物。

senses.title: A grouping visible to the eye
senses.definition: a group of stars that appears as a knot of light to the naked eye or in binoculars
senses.definitionCN: 肉眼或双筒望远镜中呈现为一团光的星群
senses.example: To the naked eye the star cluster looks like a fuzzy patch.
senses.exampleCN: 肉眼看去，这个星团像一小片模糊的光。
senses.why: before photography, the visible knot was the only evidence, so the everyday sense names what an observer actually sees.
senses.whyCN: 在摄影之前，可见的那团光就是唯一证据，因此日常义指观测者真正看到的东西。

senses.title: Figurative: a dense group
senses.titleCN: 比喻义：密集聚在一起的一群
senses.definition: a figurative use for a dense gathering of similar people or things
senses.definitionCN: 比喻同类的人或物密集聚在一起
senses.example: A star cluster of start-ups grew around the old port.
senses.exampleCN: 旧港周围长出了一片「星团」般的初创企业。
senses.why: the metaphor keeps the two features that matter: many separate points, and one centre they all orbit.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻保留两个关键特征：许多分开的点，以及它们共同绕行的中心。

intro.en: Star cluster is a compound of native English star and cluster, a word for a bunch; the astronomical sense is a nineteenth-century specialization. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: star cluster 由英语本族的 star「星」与 cluster「一簇」构成复合词；天文义是 19 世纪的专业化用法。年代均为约数。

items.en: Star descends from Old English steorra and belongs to the Germanic stock; Latin stella is a cognate, not its source.
items.cn: star 承自古英语 steorra，属日耳曼词集；拉丁 stella 是同源词，并非其来源。

items.en: Cluster is recorded in Old English in the sense of a bunch or mass, related to clot and to the idea of things sticking together.
items.cn: cluster 在古英语中已有「一束、一团」之义，与 clot 相关，带「粘在一起」的意思。

items.en: Star cluster is generally believed to have settled as an astronomical term in the nineteenth century, when catalogues began listing groups separately from single stars.
items.cn: 一般认为，star cluster 在 19 世纪定型为天文术语，当时星表开始把星群与单颗恒星分开著录。

items.en: Open and globular clusters were distinguished in the same period, as the shape and spacing of the two kinds became measurable.
items.cn: 同一时期，疏散星团与球状星团被区分开来，因为这两类的形状与间距变得可测量。

items.en: Root uncertainty: the deeper origin of cluster is a reconstruction, and its link to clot is generally accepted but not proven. First-date uncertainty only: the earliest printed use of the exact phrase star cluster is not recorded.
items.cn: 词根存疑：cluster 的更深来源属重构，它与 clot 的联系一般认为成立但未获证明。仅首见年代存疑：star cluster 这一确切短语的最早印刷记录不明。

note.en: Group one holds astronomical groupings that are often mistaken for a cluster; group two holds the everyday words for groups that the figurative sense borrows.
note.cn: 第一组是常被误认为星团的天文分组；第二组是比喻义借用的日常「群」词。

entries.tag: a pattern not a physical group
entries.definition: Its stars may lie at wildly different distances; a constellation is a line of sight, while a cluster is a real group bound by gravity.
entries.definitionCN: 其中各星距离可能相差极大；星座只是视线方向，星团才是真正被引力束缚的一群。

entries.definition: A recognized shape such as the Big Dipper, not necessarily bound; the Pleiades is both an asterism and a cluster, which is why the terms are confused.
entries.definitionCN: 如北斗七星那样被认出的形状，未必受束缚；昴星团既是星群也是星团，因此两者常被混淆。

entries.definition: A galaxy contains thousands of clusters; the words differ by scale, not by kind.
entries.definitionCN: 一个星系包含成千上万个星团；两词差别在尺度，而非种类。

entries.definition: The general noun for things gathered closely; star cluster specifies what is gathered.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指聚在一起之物；star cluster 指明所聚的是恒星。

entries.definition: Any set of objects treated together, with no claim of gravity or common origin.
entries.definitionCN: 任何被一起看待的一组，不承诺引力或共同来源。

entries.definition: In astronomy, a very loose group of young stars not tightly bound; looser than a cluster.
entries.definitionCN: 天文学中指束缚很松的年轻恒星群，比星团更松散。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: star + cluster: stars bunched together.
normal.cn: star + cluster：星被束成一团。

normal.en: Two main types: open and globular.
normal.cn: 两大类型：疏散与球状。

normal.en: Same birth cloud, same age: siblings.
normal.cn: 同一诞生云、同一年龄：一群兄弟姐妹。

normal.en: The family runs cluster, clustered, clustering, starry, stellar.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 cluster、clustered、clustering、starry、stellar。

normal.en: Not every pattern is a cluster: constellations may be far apart.
normal.cn: 不是每个图案都是星团：星座各星可能相距极远。

abstract.en: Picture fireflies tied to one another by invisible threads, circling a lamp.
abstract.cn: 想象萤火虫被看不见的线相互拴住，绕着一盏灯转。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd on a square all walking around the same fountain.
abstract.cn: 想象广场上的人群都绕着同一座喷泉走。

abstract.en: Picture a family album where every photo was taken on the same day.
abstract.cn: 想象一本家庭相册，每张照片都摄于同一天。

examples.en: The star cluster contains several hundred young stars.
examples.cn: 这个星团包含数百颗年轻恒星。

examples.en: Globular star clusters are among the oldest objects in the galaxy.
examples.cn: 球状星团是星系中最古老的天体之一。

examples.en: Astronomers measured the star cluster's distance from its colour.
examples.cn: 天文学家借颜色测出这个星团的距离。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「star（星）+ cluster（一簇）」——聚成一簇的星 → 星团

root: 古英语 steorra「星」+ 古英语 cluster「一束、一团」（与 clot 相关）；天文义一般认为在 19 世纪定型。拉丁 stella 仅为 star 的同源词。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one knot: stars held together, then the loose and dense kinds, the shared birthday, the laboratory they provide, their role as galaxy markers, the naked-eye patch and finally any dense gathering with one centre.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一团结展开：被束缚在一起的一群星；再分松散与紧密两类、共同的诞生日、它们提供的实验室、作为星系标记的角色、肉眼所见的一团光，最后是任何有共同中心的密集聚集。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: hundreds of lights packed into one small patch, circling a common centre.
core.cn: 核心意象：几百个光点挤在一小片天区，绕着共同中心转。

branches.en: THE BINDING: mutual gravity is what makes a cluster more than a pattern.
branches.cn: 束缚：相互引力才使星团不只是图案。

branches.en: SHAPE AND SPACING: loose open groups, dense globular balls, and the fuzzy patch seen by eye.
branches.cn: 形状与间距：松散的疏散群、紧密的球状团，以及肉眼所见的一团光。

branches.en: ONE BIRTH, MANY MASSES: shared age turns members into a controlled sample.
branches.cn: 同一次诞生、多种质量：共同年龄使成员成为对照样本。

branches.en: TRACERS: bright clusters mark the structure of a whole galaxy.
branches.cn: 示踪物：明亮的星团标出整个星系的结构。

branches.en: THE METAPHOR: many points gathered around one centre.
branches.cn: 比喻：许多点围绕一个中心聚拢。

intro.en: The phrase joins a native star to a native cluster; neither half is Latin, though stellar relatives entered English separately.
intro.cn: 这个短语把本族的 star 与本族的 cluster 并置；两半都不是拉丁语，只是 stellar 一类的同源词另行进入英语。

latinIntro.en: Latin stella is a cognate of star and supplies stellar and constellation, but cluster has no Latin source; it is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 stella 是 star 的同源词，并给出 stellar 与 constellation；cluster 没有拉丁来源，属日耳曼语。

items.example: The first half is a free native noun.
items.exampleCN: 前半是自由的本族名词。

items.example: The second half is also native.
items.exampleCN: 后半同样是本族词。

items.example: Clustered means gathered into clusters.
items.exampleCN: clustered 意为聚集成团的。

items.example: Clustering names the process of gathering.
items.exampleCN: clustering 指聚集成团的过程。

items.example: The compound is a modern astronomical label.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词是近代天文标签。

items.example: Open describes the spacing, not openness to view.
items.exampleCN: open 描述间距松散，而非「开放观看」。

items.example: The Latin element supplies the shape word.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁成分提供形状词。

items.example: A borrowed relative of star, not a part of this phrase.
items.exampleCN: 这是 star 的借入同源词，不是本短语的成分。

items.example: A pattern need not be bound, unlike a cluster.
items.exampleCN: 图形不必受束缚，星团则不然。
